theorems.title_en: The Pythagorean Theorem — Step-by-Step Visual Proof by Square Area Partition
theorems.precondition_ko: 직각을 낀 두 변 a, b와 빗변 c에 대해 한 변이 a+b인 정사각형을 4개 직각삼각형과 넓이 c^2인 중앙 정사각형으로 분할한 넓이 등식 조건에서 a^2 + b^2 = c^2 을 형식 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: Given the outer square area partition (a + b)^2 = c^2 + 2ab formed by four right triangles with legs a, b and hypotenuse c, prove a^2 + b^2 = c^2 over Int.
theorems.lean_code:
-- 1. [2017090101] Pythagorean Theorem via Square Area Dissection
theorem pythagorean_square_dissection
    (a b c : Int)
    (h_partition : (a + b) * (a + b) = c * c + 2 * (a * b)) :
    a * a + b * b = c * c := by
  grind

theorems.title_en: Ceva's Theorem — Step-by-Step Visual Proof via Triangle Area Ratios
theorems.precondition_ko: 양수 넓이 sA, sB, sC > 0를 갖는 삼각형 내부 분할에서 밑변비와 넓이비 비례식(bd*sC = dc*sB 등 3식)이 성립하면 체바 곱 등식 bd*ce*af = dc*ea*fb 가 필연적으로 성립함을 형식 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: Given positive sub-triangle areas sA, sB, sC > 0 and shared-altitude area proportions along sides BC, CA, AB, cancel positive area factors in Lean 4 to prove bd * ce * af = dc * ea * fb.
theorems.lean_code:
-- 2. [2014111902] Ceva's Theorem via Triangle Area Ratios
theorem ceva_area_ratio_concurrency
    (bd dc ce ea af fb sA sB sC : Int)
    (hsA : sA > 0) (hsB : sB > 0) (hsC : sC > 0)
    (h1 : bd * sC = dc * sB)
    (h2 : ce * sA = ea * sC)
    (h3 : af * sB = fb * sA) :
    bd * ce * af = dc * ea * fb := by
  have hprod : (bd * ce * af) * (sA * sB * sC) = (dc * ea * fb) * (sA * sB * sC) := by
    calc
      (bd * ce * af) * (sA * sB * sC)
          = (bd * sC) * (ce * sA) * (af * sB) := by grind
      _   = (dc * sB) * (ea * sC) * (fb * sA) := by rw [h1, h2, h3]
      _   = (dc * ea * fb) * (sA * sB * sC) := by grind
  have hs : sA * sB * sC ≠ 0 := by
    have h12 : 0 < sA * sB := Int.mul_pos hsA hsB
    have h123 : 0 < sA * sB * sC := Int.mul_pos h12 hsC
    omega
  exact Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hs hprod

theorems.title_en: Menelaus' Theorem — Step-by-Step Visual Proof with Parallel Auxiliary Line
theorems.precondition_ko: 평행 보조선 선분 길이 ck > 0와 닮음 보조 선분 p, q > 0에 대한 3개의 닮음 비례식으로부터 메넬라우스 곱 등식 bd*ce*af = dc*ea*fb 를 약분 소거로 형식 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: Using positive parallel-auxiliary segment measures ck, p, q > 0 and three similarity proportions across a transversal, formally prove bd * ce * af = dc * ea * fb.
theorems.lean_code:
-- 3. [2014111901] Menelaus' Theorem via Parallel Auxiliary Segment
theorem menelaus_parallel_ratio_product
    (bd dc ce ea af fb ck p q : Int)
    (hck : ck > 0) (hp : p > 0) (hq : q > 0)
    (h1 : bd * ck = dc * p)
    (h2 : ce * q = ea * ck)
    (h3 : af * p = fb * q) :
    bd * ce * af = dc * ea * fb := by
  have hprod : (bd * ce * af) * (ck * p * q) = (dc * ea * fb) * (ck * p * q) := by
    calc
      (bd * ce * af) * (ck * p * q)
          = (bd * ck) * (ce * q) * (af * p) := by grind
      _   = (dc * p) * (ea * ck) * (fb * q) := by rw [h1, h2, h3]
      _   = (dc * ea * fb) * (ck * p * q) := by grind
  have hnz : ck * p * q ≠ 0 := by
    have h12 : 0 < ck * p := Int.mul_pos hck hp
    have h123 : 0 < ck * p * q := Int.mul_pos h12 hq
    omega
  exact Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hnz hprod

theorems.title_ko: 실수에서의 코시 슈바르츠 부등식(Cauchy Schwarz inequality in R)
theorems.precondition_ko: 2차원 정수 벡터 (a1, a2), (b1, b2)에 대해 라그랑주 항등식과 완전제곱의 비음수성((a1*b2 - a2*b1)^2 >= 0)을 결합해 코시-슈바르츠 부등식을 논리 공백 없이 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: Combine the 2D Lagrange identity with non-negativity of a square over Int to formally prove (a1*b1 + a2*b2)^2 <= (a1^2 + a2^2)*(b1^2 + b2^2).
theorems.lean_code:
-- 4. [2014080601] Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality in R^2 via Lagrange Identity
theorem cauchy_schwarz_lagrange_r2
    (a1 a2 b1 b2 : Int) :
    (a1 * b1 + a2 * b2) * (a1 * b1 + a2 * b2)
      ≤ (a1 * a1 + a2 * a2) * (b1 * b1 + b2 * b2) := by
  have h_id :
      (a1 * a1 + a2 * a2) * (b1 * b1 + b2 * b2) =
        (a1 * b1 + a2 * b2) * (a1 * b1 + a2 * b2) +
        (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1) * (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1) := by
    grind
  have h_sq : 0 ≤ (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1) * (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1) := by
    by_cases hsign : 0 ≤ a1 * b2 - a2 * b1
    · exact Int.mul_nonneg hsign hsign
    · have hneg : a1 * b2 - a2 * b1 ≤ 0 := by omega
      exact Int.mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hneg hneg
  omega

theorems.precondition_ko: 등차중항 조건 2*m = a + b 로부터 대칭 간격 m - a = b - m 과 완전제곱 항등식 (a+b)^2 >= 4ab 를 동시에 형식 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: From the arithmetic mean relation 2*m = a + b, formally prove equal deviation m - a = b - m together with 4*(a*b) <= (a + b)^2.
theorems.lean_code:
-- 5. [2020062702] Arithmetic Mean Midpoint & Square Inequality
theorem arithmetic_mean_and_square_inequality
    (a b m : Int)
    (h_mean : 2 * m = a + b) :
    m - a = b - m ∧ 4 * (a * b) ≤ (a + b) * (a + b) := by
  have h_sq : 0 ≤ (a - b) * (a - b) := by
    by_cases hsign : 0 ≤ a - b
    · exact Int.mul_nonneg hsign hsign
    · have hneg : a - b ≤ 0 := by omega
      exact Int.mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hneg hneg
  have h_id : (a + b) * (a + b) = 4 * (a * b) + (a - b) * (a - b) := by
    grind
  constructor
  · omega
  · omega

theorems.title_ko: 삼각형의 세 변의 수직이등분선은 한 점(외심)에서 만나고 이 점(외심)에서 세 꼭짓점에 이르는 거리는 같다.(The vertical bisector of the three sides of the triangle meet at one point (circumcenter) and the distance from this point (circumcenter) to the three vertices is the same.)
theorems.title_en: The vertical bisector of the three sides of the triangle meet at one point (circumcenter) and the distance from this point (circumcenter) to the three vertices is the same.
theorems.precondition_ko: 변 AB의 수직이등분선 조건 dOA = dOB와 변 BC의 수직이등분선 조건 dOB = dOC가 만나면 세 꼭짓점까지의 거리가 모두 같음(dOA = dOC)을 전이성으로 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: From perpendicular bisector equidistance dOA = dOB and dOB = dOC, formally prove concurrency equidistance dOA = dOC to all three vertices.
theorems.lean_code:
-- 6. [2017091805] Circumcenter Concurrency of Perpendicular Bisectors
theorem circumcenter_perpendicular_bisectors_concurrency
    (dOA dOB dOC : Int)
    (hAB : dOA = dOB)
    (hBC : dOB = dOC) :
    dOA = dOC ∧ dOA = dOB ∧ dOB = dOC := by
  exact ⟨Eq.trans hAB hBC, hAB, hBC⟩

theorems.title_en: The bisector of three angles of a triangle meet at one point(incenter) and the distance from this point(incenter) to the three sides is the same.
theorems.precondition_ko: 내각의 이등분선 교점의 세 변까지 거리 일치(dAB = dBC = dCA)와 내접원 반지름 r에 의한 세 삼각형 2배 넓이 합 2*(S1+S2+S3) = r*(a+b+c)를 동시 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: Prove triple-distance equality from two angle bisectors alongside the doubled triangle area partition 2*(areaBC + areaCA + areaAB) = r*(a + b + c).
theorems.lean_code:
-- 7. [2017091809] Incenter Equidistance & Inradius Area Partition
theorem incenter_angle_bisectors_and_inradius_area
    (r a b c areaBC areaCA areaAB dAB dBC dCA : Int)
    (h1 : dAB = dBC) (h2 : dBC = dCA)
    (hBC : 2 * areaBC = r * a)
    (hCA : 2 * areaCA = r * b)
    (hAB : 2 * areaAB = r * c) :
    dAB = dCA ∧ 2 * (areaBC + areaCA + areaAB) = r * (a + b + c) := by
  constructor
  · exact Eq.trans h1 h2
  · grind

theorems.title_en: Given a line segment, distances from a point on the perpendicular bisector to the each end point of the line segment are same.
theorems.precondition_ko: 좌표평면에서 선분 AB의 중점 M(2*mx = ax+bx, 2*my = ay+by_)과 수직 내적 조건 PM·AB = 0이 주어지면 |PA|^2 = |PB|^2 임을 직접 항등식으로 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: Given Cartesian midpoint 2*mx = ax + bx, 2*my = ay + by_ and dot-product orthogonality to AB, prove squared distance equality distSq(P, A) = distSq(P, B).
theorems.lean_code:
-- 8. [2019111301] Equidistance on a Perpendicular Bisector (Coordinate Proof)
theorem perpendicular_bisector_equidistance
    (ax ay bx by_ mx my px py : Int)
    (hmx : 2 * mx = ax + bx)
    (hmy : 2 * my = ay + by_)
    (hperp : (px - mx) * (bx - ax) + (py - my) * (by_ - ay) = 0) :
    (px - ax) * (px - ax) + (py - ay) * (py - ay) =
      (px - bx) * (px - bx) + (py - by_) * (py - by_) := by
  have h_diff :
      ((px - ax) * (px - ax) + (py - ay) * (py - ay)) -
      ((px - bx) * (px - bx) + (py - by_) * (py - by_)) =
        2 * ((px - mx) * (bx - ax) + (py - my) * (by_ - ay)) := by
    grind
  rw [hperp] at h_diff
  omega

theorems.precondition_en: From base diagonal dBaseSq = a^2 + b^2 and prism height c, prove dSpaceSq = a^2 + b^2 + c^2 and machine-verify 6^2 + 3^2 + 5^2 = 70.
theorems.lean_code:
-- 9. [2017091820] Space Diagonal of a Rectangular Prism (6-3-5 Example)
theorem space_diagonal_6_3_5_prism
    (a b c dBaseSq dSpaceSq : Int)
    (hbase : dBaseSq = a * a + b * b)
    (hspace : dSpaceSq = dBaseSq + c * c) :

theorems.title_ko: 이등변삼각형의 두 밑각의 크기는 같다.(The base angles of an isosceles triangle are congruent.)
theorems.title_en: The base angles of an isosceles triangle are congruent.
theorems.precondition_ko: 삼각형 내각의 합 apex + b1 + b2 = 180도와 두 밑각 합동 b1 = b2 조건으로부터 꼭지각과 두 밑각의 일반 관계식 apex + 2*b1 = 180을 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: Combine the triangle angle sum apex + b1 + b2 = 180 with congruent base angles b1 = b2 to prove apex + 2*b1 = 180 and 2*b2 = 180 - apex.
theorems.lean_code:
-- 10. [2017090405] Base Angles of an Isosceles Triangle
theorem isosceles_base_angles_sum
    (apex b1 b2 : Int)
    (hsum : apex + b1 + b2 = 180)
    (hcong : b1 = b2) :
    apex + 2 * b1 = 180 ∧ 2 * b2 = 180 - apex := by
  omega

theorems.precondition_ko: 제곱 성질 sA^2 = a, sB^2 = b를 만족하는 두 근호 항의 켤레 곱 (sA + sB)*(sA - sB)가 유리식 a - b로 정확히 소거됨을 형식 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: When sA^2 = a and sB^2 = b, formally prove that the conjugate product (sA + sB)*(sA - sB) collapses to the rationalized difference a - b.
theorems.lean_code:
-- 11. [2017032702] Denominator Rationalization via Conjugate Difference of Squares
theorem conjugate_rationalization_identity
    (a b sA sB : Int)
    (ha : sA * sA = a)
    (hb : sB * sB = b) :
    (sA + sB) * (sA - sB) = a - b := by
  grind

theorems.precondition_ko: 매 분기마다 부모 정사각형 넓이가 두 자식 정사각형 넓이의 합과 같을 때(g0 = b1 + b2, b1 = c1 + c2, b2 = c3 + c4), 2세대 4개 정사각형의 넓이 총합이 뿌리 넓이 g0로 보존됨을 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: Assuming each Pythagorean branching step preserves square area (g0 = b1 + b2, b1 = c1 + c2, b2 = c3 + c4), prove total second-generation area equals root area g0.
theorems.lean_code:
-- 12. [math20250130001] Pythagoras Tree Generational Area Conservation
theorem pythagoras_tree_area_conservation
    (g0 b1 b2 c1 c2 c3 c4 : Int)
    (hlvl1 : g0 = b1 + b2)
    (hlvl2L : b1 = c1 + c2)
    (hlvl2R : b2 = c3 + c4) :
    g0 = c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 := by
  omega

theorems.title_ko: 원에서 한 호에 대한 원주각은 중심각의 크기의 반이다.(중심이 원주각의 내부에 있을 때) (In any circle, an inscribed angle is half the size of the central angle subtending the same arc. (When the center is inside the circumference))
theorems.title_en: In any circle, an inscribed angle is half the size of the central angle subtending the same arc. (When the center is inside the circumference)
theorems.precondition_ko: 원의 중심을 지나는 지름으로 분할된 두 이등변삼각형의 외각 성질(ext1 = a1+b1, ext2 = a2+b2, a1=b1, a2=b2)로부터 중심각이 원주각의 정확히 2배임을 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: Splitting an inscribed angle by a diameter into two isosceles triangles (a1 = b1, a2 = b2) with exterior angles ext1, ext2 proves central angle = 2 * (a1 + a2).
theorems.lean_code:
-- 13. [2012093001] Inscribed Angle Theorem (Central Angle = 2x Inscribed Angle)
theorem inscribed_angle_double_central
    (a1 a2 b1 b2 ext1 ext2 : Int)
    (hisosc1 : a1 = b1) (hsum1 : ext1 = a1 + b1)
    (hisosc2 : a2 = b2) (hsum2 : ext2 = a2 + b2) :
    ext1 + ext2 = 2 * (a1 + a2) := by
  omega

theorems.title_ko: 원의 접선과 그 접점을 지나는 현이 이루는 각의 크기는 그 각의 내부에 있는 호에 대한 원주각의 크기와 같다.(현과 접선의 각이 예각일때)(An angle between a chord and a tangent is equal to any angle in the alternate segment.(when the angle of the chord and the tangent is an acute angle))
theorems.title_en: An angle between a chord and a tangent is equal to any angle in the alternate segment.(when the angle of the chord and the tangent is an acute angle)
theorems.precondition_ko: 접선-반지름 수직(tangentAngle + compAngle = 90)과 지름 위 원주각 직각(inscribedAngle + compAngle = 90)을 결합해 접선과 현이 이루는 각이 원주각과 같음을 증명합니다.
theorems.precondition_en: Combine tangent-radius perpendicularity (tangentAngle + compAngle = 90) and the diameter right-angle relation (inscribedAngle + compAngle = 90) to prove tangentAngle = inscribedAngle.
theorems.lean_code:

    (tangentAngle compAngle inscribedAngle : Int)
    (htan : tangentAngle + compAngle = 90)
    (htri : inscribedAngle + compAngle = 90) :
    tangentAngle = inscribedAngle := by
  omega

theorem menelaus_parallel_ratio_product
    (bd dc ce ea af fb ck p q : Int)
    (hck : ck > 0) (hp : p > 0) (hq : q > 0)
    (h1 : bd * ck = dc * p)
    (h2 : ce * q = ea * ck)
    (h3 : af * p = fb * q) :
    bd * ce * af = dc * ea * fb := by
  have hprod : (bd * ce * af) * (ck * p * q) = (dc * ea * fb) * (ck * p * q) := by
    calc
      (bd * ce * af) * (ck * p * q)
          = (bd * ck) * (ce * q) * (af * p) := by grind
      _   = (dc * p) * (ea * ck) * (fb * q) := by rw [h1, h2, h3]
      _   = (dc * ea * fb) * (ck * p * q) := by grind
  have hnz : ck * p * q ≠ 0 := by
    have h12 : 0 < ck * p := Int.mul_pos hck hp
    have h123 : 0 < ck * p * q := Int.mul_pos h12 hq
    omega
  exact Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hnz hprod

2014080601.title_ko: 실수에서의 코시 슈바르츠 부등식(Cauchy Schwarz inequality in R)
2014080601.precondition_ko: 2차원 정수 벡터 (a1, a2), (b1, b2)에 대해 라그랑주 항등식과 완전제곱의 비음수성((a1*b2 - a2*b1)^2 >= 0)을 결합해 코시-슈바르츠 부등식을 논리 공백 없이 증명합니다.
2014080601.precondition_en: Combine the 2D Lagrange identity with non-negativity of a square over Int to formally prove (a1*b1 + a2*b2)^2 <= (a1^2 + a2^2)*(b1^2 + b2^2).
2014080601.lean_code:
-- 4. [2014080601] Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality in R^2 via Lagrange Identity
theorem cauchy_schwarz_lagrange_r2
    (a1 a2 b1 b2 : Int) :
    (a1 * b1 + a2 * b2) * (a1 * b1 + a2 * b2)
      ≤ (a1 * a1 + a2 * a2) * (b1 * b1 + b2 * b2) := by
  have h_id :
      (a1 * a1 + a2 * a2) * (b1 * b1 + b2 * b2) =
        (a1 * b1 + a2 * b2) * (a1 * b1 + a2 * b2) +
        (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1) * (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1) := by
    grind
  have h_sq : 0 ≤ (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1) * (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1) := by
    by_cases hsign : 0 ≤ a1 * b2 - a2 * b1
    · exact Int.mul_nonneg hsign hsign
    · have hneg : a1 * b2 - a2 * b1 ≤ 0 := by omega
      exact Int.mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hneg hneg
  omega

2020062702.precondition_ko: 등차중항 조건 2*m = a + b 로부터 대칭 간격 m - a = b - m 과 완전제곱 항등식 (a+b)^2 >= 4ab 를 동시에 형식 증명합니다.
2020062702.precondition_en: From the arithmetic mean relation 2*m = a + b, formally prove equal deviation m - a = b - m together with 4*(a*b) <= (a + b)^2.
2020062702.lean_code:
-- 5. [2020062702] Arithmetic Mean Midpoint & Square Inequality
theorem arithmetic_mean_and_square_inequality
    (a b m : Int)
    (h_mean : 2 * m = a + b) :
    m - a = b - m ∧ 4 * (a * b) ≤ (a + b) * (a + b) := by
  have h_sq : 0 ≤ (a - b) * (a - b) := by
    by_cases hsign : 0 ≤ a - b
    · exact Int.mul_nonneg hsign hsign
    · have hneg : a - b ≤ 0 := by omega
      exact Int.mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hneg hneg
  have h_id : (a + b) * (a + b) = 4 * (a * b) + (a - b) * (a - b) := by
    grind
  constructor
  · omega
  · omega

    (r a b c areaBC areaCA areaAB dAB dBC dCA : Int)

-- 8. [2019111301] Equidistance on a Perpendicular Bisector (Coordinate Proof)
theorem perpendicular_bisector_equidistance
    (ax ay bx by_ mx my px py : Int)
    (hmx : 2 * mx = ax + bx)
    (hmy : 2 * my = ay + by_)
    (hperp : (px - mx) * (bx - ax) + (py - my) * (by_ - ay) = 0) :
    (px - ax) * (px - ax) + (py - ay) * (py - ay) =
      (px - bx) * (px - bx) + (py - by_) * (py - by_) := by
  have h_diff :
      ((px - ax) * (px - ax) + (py - ay) * (py - ay)) -
      ((px - bx) * (px - bx) + (py - by_) * (py - by_)) =
        2 * ((px - mx) * (bx - ax) + (py - my) * (by_ - ay)) := by
    grind
  rw [hperp] at h_diff
  omega
